arguments.value: Timothy J. Savage was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, in 1946. He earned his B.A. from Assumption College in 1968 and his J.D. from Temple University School of Law in 1971. After entering private practice in Pennsylvania, he served as a hearing examiner for the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board from 1976 to 2002. On March 21, 2002, President George W. Bush nominated him to the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, and he was confirmed by the Senate and received his commission on August 1, 2002. He assumed senior status on March 1, 2021.
